title: i'm measuring 1,900 biomarkers over the next 100 days to better understand female biology

segments.text: I'm going to become the world's most measured female in this process. I'm about to embark on an insane journey to understand the female body. Over the next 100 days, I'm going to be measuring 1,900 biomarkers in my body to do the world's first experiment where we extensively characterize female biology.

For too long, women have been dismissed, understudied, or given the same treatments as men. Every single day, on a regular day, I'm going to do 80 things, 80 tasks. This will be things like measuring my hormones, doing red light, measuring my brain age, my face age, my grip strength. I'm really giving up my normal life with this process, and I'm a creative chaotic being. I like to stay up late. I like to do things not according to a schedule. Female health has been behind in the medical community, and so it's time that we start to really investigate this. And I don't want to wait for clinical trials to come up, which cost many millions of dollars and typically take decades to

do. So, this is our N of 1 experiment. Obviously, what I'm doing is not for you to do. I feel so honored to be in this position to be able to do this and have the privilege of all the access to these tests so we can finally figure out what's going on for women. Any practical tips we can glean from this information, we'll be publishing it with you so you can adjust your behaviors at home. So, I'm hopeful that we can find all these small little things that help everyday women understand themselves and also be able to articulate themselves to other people as well. Join us and we'll share everything online.
